items.title: Boeing Q2 revenue tops estimates as jet deliveries climb, cash turns positive
items.summary: Boeing (BA) reported second quarter results on Tuesday that beat revenue and cash flow expectations, as rising jet deliveries pushed the planemaker to positive free cash flow, continuing CEO Kelly Ortberg's turnaround progress.

items.title: Boeing Reports Wider-Than-Expected Second-Quarter Loss Despite Revenue Beat
items.summary: Boeing Co. (NYSE:BA) reported a larger-than-expected adjusted loss for the second quarter, although revenue exceeded market forecasts as aircraft deliveries increased and the aerospace manufacturer generated positive cash flow.

items.title: Boeing reports loss on Air Force One but sees progress in turnaround
items.summary: Boeing reported a bigger-than-expected loss Tuesday fuelled by $280 million in additional costs in outfitting two US presidential planes, but said broad-based revenue growth showed progress after several troubled years.Boeing reported a second-quarter loss of $428 million, smaller than in the year-ago period, but bigger than projected by analysts.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Tech Futures Sell Off As Chip Stocks Micron, Sandisk Dive; Coca-Cola Jumps (Live Coverage)
items.summary: Stock Market Today: The Dow Jones index rose, but tech futures dropped as chip stocks Micron and Sandisk dived. Coca-Cola jumped on earnings.

items.title: Boeing (NYSE:BA) Posts Better-Than-Expected Sales In Q2 CY2026
items.summary: Aerospace and defense company Boeing (NYSE:BA) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 8% year on year to $24.56 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.76 per share was significantly above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Boeing Stock Rises Even as Earnings Are Weaker Than Expected
items.summary: Boeing reports a second-quarter operating profit of $156 million. Wall Street was looking for closer to $460 million.

items.title: Corning, ASML, PayPal, UPS, Boeing, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: ASML, Sandisk, Micron, and other AI stocks struggle as investors fret over rising costs and competition from China.

items.title: Boeing Shares Fight To Regain Support; Q2 Results Don't Help
items.summary: Boeing cleared Q2 sales estimates as commercial airplane deliveries grow. FAA highlights seat installation issue. BA stock rises.
